_doc: L0f expected-output contract — the frozen TDD assertion skeleton for the knowledge-tier (guild.knowledge_graph.v2). Every K-lane (L1–L5, L8, L11) and the per-SC evals (L9) load THIS file and assert against the named section. The all-valid graph projection of this corpus is `expected-graph.v2.json` (passes validateGraphV2 with repoRoot = this directory). Negative fixtures live in `bad-nodes.json`.
_determinism_caveat: IDs below are split into TWO classes. (1) FULLY DETERMINISTIC from the corpus alone — assert these EXACTLY: wiki_page:<relpath>, diagram:<anchor>, entity:<normalized-name>, code file/function ids, all `related` edges, the subtopic_of tree shape, anchors. (2) DERIVED FROM AN LLM-JUDGED INTERMEDIATE — topic ids (= makeTopicId(sortedMemberIds)) and claim/concept ids (= make*Id(anchor, extractedText)) are reproducible ONLY if the stage extracts the member-set / claim-text pinned here. K-lane tests should assert STRUCTURE + ANCHORS for these (min counts, depth, ordering, presence of a link by anchor-pair), and assert the exact hashed id ONLY in tests that also fix the membership/text input (i.e. when unit-testing the deterministic id helper, not the LLM stage). Do NOT fail a correct LLM stage because it named a topic differently.

config._doc: KNOWLEDGE_CONFIG_DEFAULTS the corpus was designed against.

ids._doc: Concrete deterministic ids computed by the real schema helpers against the pinned member-sets / claim-text. See _determinism_caveat for which to assert exactly.

topic_member_sets._doc: makeTopicId(sortedMemberIds) inputs — the pinned cluster membership behind each topic id.

validated_before_persist.text: Every incoming event is validated before it is persisted.

append_only.text: Events are stored append-only and never mutated.

field_contract._doc: Required-field match rules for EVERY asserted node/edge in this file (closes the oracle-tightness class flagged at codex G-lane round 1). schema.ts requires GraphEdge{source,target,type,direction,weight} and GraphNode{id,type,name,source_refs,confidence}. A per-SC block asserts the SC-discriminating SUBSET; this contract states how each required field must be checked so a wrong/missing required field can never silently pass. expected-graph.v2.json is the AUTHORITATIVE full-shape oracle — it carries every required field at its pinned value and round-trips validateGraphV2; per-SC subsets are read under these rules.

edge_required_fields.type: HARD — match exactly (closed v2 edge set).
edge_required_fields.direction: HARD — match exactly. Every seeded edge is "out"; an edge with the right source/target/type but direction "in"/"bi" is WRONG and must fail. (This was the round-1 gap.)
edge_required_fields.weight: RANGE/THRESHOLD, not exact. Required + numeric 0..1. Deterministic edges (related, subtopic_of, belongs_to_domain, defines) carry a pinned example value (1.0) but implementations need not reproduce the exact float — assert present + 0..1. LLM-scored edges (evidenced_by, relates_to) MUST satisfy weight >= relMinConf (0.5); the pinned value (e.g. 0.9/0.8/0.7/0.6) is one valid example — assert the >= relMinConf threshold, not equality.

node_required_fields.id: Per _determinism_caveat: HARD-exact for fully-deterministic types (wiki_page/diagram/entity/file/function); STRUCTURAL for LLM-coupled types (topic/claim/concept — assert anchor + count + path/depth, not the hash).
node_required_fields.type: HARD — match exactly (closed v2 node set).
node_required_fields.name: HARD-exact for wiki_page (H1 text), diagram, entity, file, function. FREE (LLM) for topic/claim/concept — do NOT fail a correct stage on a differently-worded name; assert presence (non-empty string) only.
node_required_fields.source_refs: HARD — non-empty; every anchor must RESOLVE per-form at repoRoot (SC-12). Exact anchors are pinned in `ids` + `expectations.SC-12.sample_anchors` + expected-graph.v2.json. Knowledge nodes with zero/broken refs are invalid.
node_required_fields.confidence: ENUM-PRESENT, not pinned. Required + must be one of high|medium|low. May be LLM-assigned, so assert presence + enum membership (SC-1 nodes_missing_confidence==0), not a specific value. (Fixture uses "high" throughout as a valid example.)

nodes: SC-3.wiki_page_classification (asserts category/importance/labels SUBSET; type=wiki_page, source_refs=heading anchor, confidence=enum-present per node_required_fields; id in ids.wiki_pages)

SC-1.check: Article/topic extraction: concept/claim/entity nodes from md + doc-comments; every node carries >=1 resolvable anchor + confidence.

SC-2.check: Multi-level taxonomy: subtopic_of tree >=3 deep on the supported branch, <= maxDepth(8), fan-out <= maxBranching(12), no topic below minTopicImportance(0.4), acyclic + terminates.

SC-3.check: Wiki indexed + labeled + classified: page_count == wiki_page node count; every [[wikilink]] -> a 1:1 `related` edge; every wiki_page has non-null category + importance + labels[].

wikilink_resolution_map._doc: How each [[basename]] in the corpus resolves to a wiki_page relpath (basenames are unique).

SC-4.check: Cross-modal relations: evidenced_by links each claim/topic to its supporting artifact, keyed on a deterministic anchor; a traversal reaches the code node from its doc claim in <=2 hops.

SC-5.check: Semantic domains: domains are behavioral and must NOT equal a bare top-level directory name; topics nest under domains via belongs_to_domain; each domain has >=1 topic.

SC-6.check: Classification + labeling schema: category (closed enum), importance (high|medium|low), confidence (0-1 string here), labels[], topic_path; validator rejects out-of-enum category; wiki-lint flags a node missing importance.

SC-7.check: Diagram analysis v1: deterministic mermaid node/edge extraction + svg label text; diagram/concept nodes anchored path#mermaid-N / path#svg, linked to topics. Runs before cross-modal link (SC-4).

SC-9.check: Determinism boundary: a per-field responsibility table classifies every emitted field as deterministic-script or LLM-judged; no field claimed deterministic that calls a model.

SC-11.check: Idempotent re-run + dedup: two consecutive runs on the fixture yield byte-identical artifacts (0 net node/edge delta). validateGraphV2 canonical-sorts before dedup so output is input-order-independent.

SC-12.check: Deterministic anchors: every knowledge node resolves to a source artifact via a deterministic anchor — code path#Lx-Ly, doc/wiki path#heading-slug, diagram path#mermaid-N / path#svg.

SC-13.check: Recall-ranking: kg-query ranks knowledge nodes using importance + confidence + topic proximity; a recall query returns the high-importance topic above a low-importance sibling, under the budget cap.
SC-13.expected_ranking: topic:79c825b8 ranks above topic:189866d8 for a query touching both

notes_for_lane_owners._all_lanes: Read `field_contract` before writing edge/node assertions: source/target/type/direction match exactly; edge weight is range/threshold (>= relMinConf for evidenced_by/relates_to); node name is FREE for topic/claim/concept; confidence is enum-present not pinned. expected-graph.v2.json is the authoritative full-shape oracle for every required field.
notes_for_lane_owners.L1_content_analyze: Assert SC-1 min_nodes_by_type + every_node_has_resolvable_anchor + nodes_missing_confidence==0. claim/concept ids are text-derived (see _determinism_caveat) — assert anchors + counts, not the hash, unless you fix the extracted text.
notes_for_lane_owners.L2_wiki_index: Assert SC-3: page_count==wiki_page_node_count(6), all 8 expected_related_edges present 1:1, every wiki_page classification matches. wiki_page ids are fully deterministic (wiki_page:<relpath>) — assert exactly.
notes_for_lane_owners.L3_diagram_analyze: Assert SC-7 mermaid nodes/edges + svg label text + element_ids; diagram ids are fully deterministic (diagram:<anchor>) — assert exactly. Must run before L5.
notes_for_lane_owners.L4_taxonomy_build: Assert SC-2 (max_subtopic_depth>=3, root_fanout<=12, all importance_scores>=0.4, acyclic) + SC-5 (no_domain_named_after_top_level_dir, belongs_to_domain edges, >=1 topic/domain). Topic ids hash member-sets — prefer asserting depth/path/ordering structure.
notes_for_lane_owners.L5_cross_link: Assert SC-4 seeded_claim_to_code (1-hop) + seeded_topic_to_diagram + every_evidenced_by_target_anchor_resolves. Code/function/diagram targets are deterministic — assert by anchor-pair.
notes_for_lane_owners.L8_classify_wiki_lint: Use bad-nodes.json: validator rejects out_of_enum_category; wiki-lint flags wiki_page_missing_importance.
notes_for_lane_owners.L11_kg_query: Assert SC-13 expected_ranking on the sibling_pair_under_root, under the token budget cap.
notes_for_lane_owners.L0_validator: expected-graph.v2.json passes validateGraphV2({repoRoot: <corpusDir>}); bad-nodes.json entries are each rejected per their `expect`.
